name: Clotho: An Audio Captioning Dataset (v2.1)
description: Clotho is an audio captioning dataset consisting of 6,974 audio samples of 15 to 30 seconds duration sourced from Freesound, each paired with 5 crowdsourced human-written natural language captions (34,870 captions total). Originally presented at ICASSP 2020 by Tampere University, Clotho v2.1 serves as the benchmark corpus for DCASE automated audio captioning and language-based audio retrieval.
